enriched_activities.desc: Lies on back in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Remains still. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep. Shifts legs. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and getting washed
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up in bed. Swings legs out of bed. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Walks to sink. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and eggs. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out bowl and pan. Closes cabinet. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into bowl. Beats eggs with fork. Pours milk into bowl. Stirs. Pours mixture into pan. Cooks eggs. Turns off stove. Picks up plate. Slides eggs onto plate. Places plate on table. Opens drawer. Takes out fork. Closes drawer. Sits down. Eats breakfast. Picks up plate. Walks to sink. Places plate in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Takes out pants. Closes wardrobe. Lays clothes on bed. Takes off towel. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to desk. Opens bag. Places stethoscope in bag. Places notebook in bag. Places pen in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health care facility
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens car door. Sits in driver's seat. Fastens seatbelt. Adjusts rearview mirror. Starts engine. Puts car in gear. Drives. Stops at traffic light. Continues driving. Parks car. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Locks car. Walks to facility entrance. Opens door. Enters building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a clinical shift caring for patients
enriched_activities.desc: Washes hands. Puts on gloves. Checks patient chart. Takes vitals. Measures blood pressure. Listens to heartbeat. Administers medication. Changes bandage. Talks to patient. Records notes. Uses computer. Answers phone. Attends meeting. Washes hands. Removes gloves.

Walks to break room. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lunch bag. Closes refrigerator. Sits at table. Opens lunch bag. Takes out sandwich. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Talks to colleague. Throws away trash. Wipes table. Stands up. Walks out of break room.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical shift, patient care and charting
enriched_activities.desc: Washes hands. Puts on gloves. Enters patient room. Checks IV drip. Adjusts flow rate. Talks to patient. Records vitals. Administers injection. Removes gloves. Washes hands. Uses computer to chart. Reviews test results. Consults with doctor. Updates patient records. Attends handover meeting. Washes hands. Removes gloves.

Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens car door. Sits in driver's seat. Fastens seatbelt. Starts engine. Drives. Stops at traffic light. Continues driving. Parks car. Turns off engine. Unfastens seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Locks car. Walks to house. Opens front door. Enters house.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cabinet. Takes out cutting board and knife. Closes cabinet. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Cuts meat. Opens drawer. Takes out pan. Closes drawer. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Pours oil into pan. Adds meat. Stirs. Adds vegetables. Cooks. Turns off stove. Picks up plate. Slides food onto plate. Places plate on table. Opens drawer. Takes out fork. Closes drawer. Sits down. Eats dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from table. Picks up plate. Walks to sink. Places plate in sink. Picks up glass. Places glass in sink. Opens dishwasher. Places dishes in dishwasher. Closes dishwasher. Turns on tap. Picks up sponge. Applies soap. Washes remaining dishes. Rinses dishes. Places dishes in drying rack. Turns off tap. Wipes counter with cloth. Throws away trash. Sweeps floor.

Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out drink. Closes refrigerator. Walks back to living room. Sits on couch. Drinks. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Stands up.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Walks to sink. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Wipes face with towel. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and checking phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Scrolls through messages. Opens social media. Scrolls feed. Watches video. Closes app. Checks email. Puts down phone. Stands up. Walks to desk. Picks up book. Reads. Puts down book. Turns on desk lamp. Turns off main light. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep. Turns to other side. Adjusts pillow. Breathes deeply. Remains asleep. Shifts position. Continues sleeping.
